name: walnut-farm-manager
description: PUFAM — Ag Manager. Mixed-farm tools: mapping, diary, blight risk, and team coordination.
//desktop: Electron/electron-builder fields. Unused by Vite, Vitest, and Capacitor. productName drives ~/.config/PUF-AM and %APPDATA%\PUF-AM — see Plans/NAMING.md §2; changing it strands operator data.

scripts.//build:android: Vite build for Capacitor + `cap sync`. Bakes VITE_MIST_EXPERIMENTAL=true so the mist storage chooser reaches the APK, the same way desktop:build:web does for the Electron shell — Android has no preload bridge to un-gate it at runtime. See Plans/APK_FREENET_PLUGIN.md §6.
scripts.build:android: node scripts/build-android-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:firebase: node scripts/build-android-web.mjs --no-mist && npx cap sync android
scripts.//apk:debug: One command from a clean tree to android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk. Needs a JDK + Android SDK (android/local.properties).
scripts.//desktop:build:web: Vite build for the desktop shell — bakes VITE_MIST_EXPERIMENTAL=true so the packaged app shows the Mist/Freenet workshop UI. Runtime MIST_FREENET=1 only starts the node; it cannot un-gate an already-compiled bundle.
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build:web && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:start
scripts.//mist:build:slot: Rebuilds the join-slot contract WASM from units/mist-freenet/contracts/slot-contract. Needs cargo + wasm32-unknown-unknown + fdev, so it is not part of packaging — the vendored artifact is. Refuses to overwrite the pin unless --accept-new-hash, because re-pinning moves every slot address.
scripts.//desktop:dist: Packaging gates: pinned pack contract (fdev mandatory), fresh web + main bundles, then the node_modules allowlist. Vendored binaries are checked per target platform by the dist scripts below.
scripts.desktop:dist:prep: node scripts/verify-pack-contract.mjs --require-fdev && npm run desktop:build:web && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:verify:deps
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:vendor:verify && npm run desktop:dist:prep && electron-builder
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run desktop:vendor:verify:linux && npm run desktop:dist:prep && electron-builder --linux
scripts.//desktop:dist:linux:appimage: AppImage only — the rpm target needs `sudo dnf install rpm-build libxcrypt-compat` (electron-builder's bundled fpm links libcrypt.so.1, which Fedora 44 no longer ships).
scripts.desktop:dist:linux:appimage: npm run desktop:vendor:verify:linux && npm run desktop:dist:prep && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:vendor:verify:win && npm run desktop:dist:prep && electron-builder --win
scripts.//desktop:dist:win:portable: The Windows targets that build without wine. NSIS makes its uninstaller by running a stub .exe, so `desktop:dist:win` only completes on a Windows host; portable + zip skip that and produce copyable artifacts from Fedora.
scripts.desktop:dist:win:portable: npm run desktop:vendor:verify:win && npm run desktop:dist:prep && electron-builder --win portable zip
